info.title: Holo Folder API
info.description: Premium/lifetime data API. MCP uses OAuth separately. Card image fields are R2-only.

get.description:
Browse and search the card catalog with pagination.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_cards`.

Look up a card by its exact identifier.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `get_card`.

List card sets.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_sets`.

Look up a card set.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `get_set`.

List card series.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_series`.

Look up a card series.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `get_series`.

List supported card languages.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_languages`.

List Pokédex entries.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_pokemon`.

Look up a Pokédex entry.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `get_pokemon`.

List card illustrators.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `list_illustrators`.

List your accessible binders with slot counts.

Required permissions: `binders:read`. MCP tool: `list_binders`.

post.description:
Create a named binder.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `create_binder`.

patch.description:
Rename a binder.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `update_binder`.

delete.description:
Delete a binder. Populated binders need explicit confirmation.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `delete_binder`.

put.description:
Reorder all your binders.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `reorder_binders`.

get.description:
Read a binder collection and wanted printings with update fingerprints.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `list_collection`.

post.description:
Save an owned slot and wanted printings using its previous fingerprint.

Required permissions: `collection:write`. MCP tool: `save_collection_item`.

delete.description:
Remove a binder slot only if its fingerprint still matches.

Required permissions: `collection:write`. MCP tool: `delete_collection_item`.

get.description:
Read persisted binder settings.

Required permissions: `settings:read`. MCP tool: `get_settings`.

put.description:
Replace persisted collection settings and optionally a binder layout.

Required permissions: `settings:write`. MCP tool: `update_settings`.

post.description:
Read existing price evidence without contacting providers.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_prices`.

Refresh a bounded batch of card prices with existing provider cooldowns.

Required permissions: `prices:refresh`. MCP tool: `refresh_prices`.

get.description:
Read existing exact-printing market comparisons.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_price_checks`.

post.description:
Refresh eBay asking comparisons within provider limits. Set source to ebay; sold-comps refreshes are app-only.

Required permissions: `prices:refresh`. MCP tool: `refresh_price_checks`.

get.description:
Read a background comparison job.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_comparison_job`.

delete.description:
Cancel your accessible comparison job.

Required permissions: `prices:refresh`. MCP tool: `cancel_comparison_job`.

post.description:
Estimate comparison work and inspect existing jobs before starting.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `inspect_comparison_job`.

App-only: starting background comparisons through REST or MCP returns ui_only. Read, inspect and cancel existing jobs instead.

Required permissions: `prices:refresh`. MCP tool: `start_comparison_job`.

get.description:
Read all recorded price evidence with bounded keyset pagination.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_price_history`.

Read private account-lifetime committed collection history. Keyset cursor is bound to filters; private certificates and label assets are redacted. Legacy actors are Unknown. Requires current collection access.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `list_collection_audit`.

Read one private committed audit event, including safe before/after deltas retained after entity deletion. Recovery execution is not available.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `get_collection_audit`.

Read collection activity and available card price history.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_collection_analytics`.

post.description:
Resolve import identities against actual catalog records without changing the collection.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `resolve_import`.

Evaluate an asking price using existing saved market evidence.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `check_deal`.

get.description:
Read paginated Pokédex slots for a set. Use the card list for full printing details.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `get_set_slots`.

Read current eBay listings. May contact the provider.

Required permissions: `prices:refresh`. MCP tool: `get_listings`.

Read your account username and display name.

Required permissions: `settings:read`. MCP tool: `get_identity`.

patch.description:
Update your own public username or display name.

Required permissions: `settings:write`. MCP tool: `update_identity`.

get.description:
Read the public identity assigned to an accessible binder.

Required permissions: `binders:read`. MCP tool: `get_binder_identity`.

patch.description:
Set a public slug on a binder you own.

Required permissions: `sharing:manage`. MCP tool: `update_binder_identity`.

get.description:
Read sharing state. Only the collection owner may access share tokens.

Required permissions: `sharing:manage`. MCP tool: `get_sharing`.

put.description:
Enable or disable sharing on a binder you own, with explicit price disclosure.

Required permissions: `sharing:manage`. MCP tool: `update_sharing`.

get.description:
Read the collection binder appearance and revision.

Required permissions: `binders:read`. MCP tool: `get_appearance`.

put.description:
Save a binder appearance only if its revision still matches.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `update_appearance`.

get.description:
Read your current partnership and paginated invitations.

Required permissions: `partners:manage`. MCP tool: `list_partners`.

delete.description:
Disconnect your partnership. This removes your access to a partner-owned collection.

Required permissions: `partners:manage`. MCP tool: `disconnect_partner`.

post.description:
Invite a partner. Repeating a pending invitation does not create another.

Required permissions: `partners:manage`. MCP tool: `invite_partner`.

Accept an invitation addressed to your verified account email.

Required permissions: `partners:manage`. MCP tool: `accept_partner_invite`.

Reject an invitation addressed to your account.

Required permissions: `partners:manage`. MCP tool: `reject_partner_invite`.

get.description:
Read paginated account show purchases.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `list_show_purchases`.

post.description:
Record a purchase once using a client-generated purchase ID.

Required permissions: `collection:write`. MCP tool: `add_show_purchase`.

delete.description:
Undo a purchase from your accessible collection account.

Required permissions: `collection:write`. MCP tool: `remove_show_purchase`.

post.description:
Create a signed private R2 upload URL and artworkRef for the appearance design. Send the returned headers and exact file bytes.

Required permissions: `binders:write`. MCP tool: `prepare_artwork_upload`.

get.description:
Get a five-minute download URL for your private binder artwork.

Required permissions: `binders:read`. MCP tool: `get_artwork`.
